enunciado: Find the largest sum of a contiguous subarray of {-2, 1, -3, 4, -1, 2, 1, -5, 4} with brute force (every pair i, j) and with Kadane's algorithm, counting each one's operations. Repeat with a pseudo-random array of 200 elements.
objetivos: Redesign an algorithm to lower its order
Check that both versions give the same result
pistas: Brute force: for each start i, accumulate the sum up to each end j.
Kadane: the best sum ending at i is max(a[i], best_ending_at_i-1 + a[i]).
With 200 elements the difference in operations is two orders of magnitude.
